newsitem.title: GERMANY: German MP says Tehran may use journalist as pawn.
newsitem.headline: German MP says Tehran may use journalist as pawn.

text.p: A German parliamentarian said on Thursday he was concerned Tehran may try to use a detained journalist as a bargaining chip in the event that a Berlin court implicates the Iranian government in a murder case.
Rudolf Bindig, human rights spokesman for the opposition Social Democrats (SPD), told German Radio he was unaware of any legitimate reason Tehran had for arresting Iranian journalist Faraj Sarkuhi.

"I don't know that Mr. Sarkuhi committed any crimes, any crimes at least that would be recognised internationally as crimes," Bindig said. "From the regime's perspective, it may certainly be a crime' if one has contacts to foreigners."

Iran has criticised what it called German interference over the fate of Sarkuhi, who was arrested while trying to leave Iran this month, state Tehran Radio reported on Thursday. Iran has told Bonn Sarkuhi was trying to leave the country illegally.
Tehran Radio quoted foreign ministry spokesman Mahmoud Mohammadi as saying the arrest and trial of Sarkuhi was an internal affair and any foreign interference was "unacceptable."
